headlines.title: Costco Stock’s Long-Term Upside Could Come From These 3 Competitive Advantages
headlines.summary: Costco commands a valuation premium that makes even its biggest fans nervous, yet three structural advantages keep analysts bullish and renewal rates near record highs. Understanding what actually drives that loyalty reveals whether the stock deserves its lofty price or is priced for perfection.

headlines.title: Is Now a Good Time to Buy Costco Stock?
headlines.summary: Costco stock is up 104% over the past five years. Will it continue to reward investors?

headlines.title: Costco faces major food court complaints
headlines.summary: The food court is supposed to be an added perk for members, but many say it’s missing the mark.

headlines.title: Costco (COST) Brings Real Time Health Benefit Checkouts To More Than 600 Stores
headlines.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) is integrating NationsBenefits powered health benefit redemptions across more than 600 U.S. warehouse locations. The partnership enables real time, item level application of eligible health benefits directly at Costco checkout registers. Automated verification removes manual paperwork and reimbursement delays for members using approved healthcare benefit cards in store.

headlines.title: Costco vs. Target: Which Discount Retailer Should You Bet On?
headlines.summary: Costco's membership strength faces off against Target's sales momentum, digital growth and attractive valuation. Which discount retailer offers better value?

description: Costco Wholesale Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of membership warehouses in the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the United Kingdom, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Sweden, Iceland, and New Zealand. It offers merchandise, including sundries, dry groceries, candies, coolers, freezers, liquor, and tobacco; non-food merchandise comprising consumer electronics, appliances, small electrics, health and beauty aids, hardware, lawn and garden, sporting goods, tires, toys and seasonal, automotive, stamps, tickets, apparel, furniture, domestics, housewares, special order kiosks, and jewelry; and fresh food, such as meat, produce, deli, and bakery products. The company is also involved in warehouse ancillary operations, which include gasoline, pharmacies, food courts, optical, hearing aids, and tire installation centers. In addition, it engages in e-commerce, business centers, travel, and other businesses. Further, the company operates e-commerce sites; and offers branded and private-label products in various categories. The company was formerly known as Costco Companies, Inc. and changed its name to Costco Wholesale Corporation in August 1999. Costco Wholesale Corporation was founded in 1976 and is based in Issaquah, Washington.
